🦠 What is HMPV?

HMPV (Human Metapneumovirus) is a respiratory virus causing cold/flu-like symptoms

Symptoms:

🤧 Runny nose
🤒 Fever, cough
😮‍💨 Breathing issues (severe cases)

Prevention:

🧼 Wash hands
😷 Wear a mask

Manage symptoms with rest, hydration, & OTC meds. https://t.co/cGm2d6u2AZ
